facts.fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde continued in 2024 its revision of the legal framework for payment services and the issuance of electronic money, with changes to the earlier revision proposal.
facts.system: Payment services and e-money legal framework

facts.fact: In 2024 the Banco de Cabo Verde operated the SGDL settlement system daily and followed daily the interbank clearing systems making up the SICIL, completing assessments of financial market infrastructures.

systems.owner: Banco de Cabo Verde; SISP future operator
